scripts.quality:backend: npm run quality:backend:format && npm run quality:backend:lint && npm run quality:backend:typecheck && npm run quality:backend:docstrings && npm run quality:backend:test
scripts.quality:backend:format: uv run --project backend --dev ruff format --check backend
scripts.quality:backend:lint: uv run --project backend --dev ruff check backend
scripts.quality:backend:docstrings: uv run --project backend --dev python backend/scripts/check_docstrings.py backend
scripts.quality:frontend: npm run frontend:format:check && npm run frontend:lint && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:test && npm run frontend:build
scripts.quality: npm run quality:backend && npm run quality:frontend
